title: Bohrin finding outcome
description: One line of a JSON Lines file: what became of one reported finding. The error-rate method counts false accusations per 1,000 proven findings from these lines.

level.description: Only proven findings are counted; experimental ones are reported apart.

outcome.description: stands: not overturned. disputed: a dispute is open, so it counts neither way yet. withdrawn-after-dispute and contradicted-by-fixture are false accusations.

dismissed.description: A user dismissed it (bohrin ignore) without disputing it.
